text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, frog.
This is your room starting today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We ended up temporarily keeping a frog in the Trainer's Office. As for why—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The academy's animals are all candidates to be my familiars!
If they're hurt, I'll take care of them!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“Still, keeping animals in the dorms is forbidden, you see.
We were just discussing what to do about it.”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Your name is "Pero"!
I'll be taking care of you for a while, so you should have a name, right?
choice_data_list: (Well, guess I'll watch and see for a bit.)
(Well, maybe I'll watch and see for a bit.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pero, I brought you some food!
All right? Make sure you eat every last bite!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Seriously, look at how filthy you got me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No no no NOOO!
I'm not doing that workout!
I'm just not in the mood for it today!
choice_data_list: Still, I've already put together a menu, so...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My, how cheeky!
Get 'em, Pero! Teach them a lesson!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, huge success! Look at my familiar's face!
Well done, Pero!

text_block_list.name: Pero
text_block_list.text: Ribbit ribbit♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pero... I'll turn you into a splendid familiar...
...Mumble mumble.

text_block_list.name: Pero
text_block_list.text: Ribbit...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho spent time with Pero
whenever she could. Thanks to that,
Pero's injury recovered smoothly, and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hop, hop, hop, hop...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Not bad, Pero!
You're jumping properly!"
choice_data_list: The scar's barely noticeable anymore, huh.
The scar's barely noticeable anymore, is it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's a relief.
With this, you can return to your friends anytime!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: Her family might be waiting for her too.
Her family might be waiting for her too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: N-No!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh... That's right!
Look at your leg, it still looks painful, doesn't it!?
This won't do!! It's completely out of the question!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"No means no!!
Not until I say it's okay!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pero! The rain brought out tons of earthworms!
They're your absolute favorite, right? Here—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ribbit ribbit ribbit ribbit...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ? What?
choice_data_list: It sounds like frogs are croaking outside.
Sounds like frogs are croaking outside.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm! More importantly, Pero!
You're hungry, right? Eat as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Pero
text_block_list.text: Ack... Ribbit, ribbit, ribbit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
!
Wait, not you too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're my familiar!
Whatever's outside has nothi—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: With this, I can return to my friends anytime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Its family might be waiting for it, too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Its family might be waiting for it, too."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Do you want to see your friends? Your family?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ……Aaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the enclosure a bit roughly,
Sweep Tosho released the frog outside without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Dummy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Humph! Still missing your family? You're a hundred years too early to become a familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look at me, living away from my family
in the dorms! Because I'm a full-fledged adult!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And yet, what's with you, Pero?!
Missing your family is way too childish!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Come back after you've learned
to leave the nest...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the croaking of a frog echoed from outside.
Almost as if it were answering Sweep Tosho's words...
choice_data_list: I'll lend Sweep all my strength, for her sake too.
Pero, toughen up and get back here~!
Pero, get your guts straightened out and come back~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, the croaking of a frog echoed from outside.
Almost as if it were answering Sweep Tosho's words...
choice_data_list: I'll lend Sweep all my strength, for her sake too.
Pero, toughen up and get back here~!
Pero, get your guts straightened out and come back~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Now you've said it!
Then get to work on the double!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you work right by my side
and set a good example for the other familiars!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Look who's acting so high and mighty!
You've still got a long way to go yourself!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, when Pero comes back,
you'd better do your best so you can act like a proper senior familiar!
